sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily, I'm happy you are here.
Today we will talk about Thailand.
Thailand is a warm, colorful,
and friendly country in Southeast Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is Thailand?
Thailand is in Southeast Asia.
It is between Myanmar, Laos, Cambodia, and Malaysia.
It has long coasts along the Andaman Sea and the Gulf of Thailand.
Thailand has cities, jungles, mountains, and islands.
What is the capital city of Thailand?
The capital city is Bangkok.
Bangkok is a big, busy, and exciting city.
It has temples, markets, boats, and modern buildings.
Other popular cities include Chiang Mai in the North with nature and culture.
Phuket, a beach island in the South, Pataya, Ayutthaya, and Kravi.
How many people live in Thailand?
About 70 million people live in Thailand.
Many people live in cities, but also in villages, farms, and coastal areas.
Thailand is known for its kind people, smiles, and hospitality.
What language do people speak in Thailand?
People speak Thai.
It is the official language.
The Thai language uses its own alphabet and tones.
Many people also speak English, especially in cities and tourist areas.
What is the weather like in Thailand?
Thailand has a tropical climate.
It is hot and humid most of the year.
There are three seasons.
Hot season from March to May.
Rainy season from June to October.
Cool season from November to February, but still warm.
People wear light clothes and drink lots of water.
What does Thailand look like?
Thailand has many beautiful places.
White sand beaches and blue sea, green mountains and waterfalls, rice fields and villages, temples,
palaces, and floating markets.
It is a great country for travel, relaxation, and adventure.
What animals live in Thailand?
Thailand has many animals like elephants, the national animal,
monkeys, tigers, and gibbons, snakes, geckos, and frogs, colorful birds and butterflies.
In the sea, fish, turtles, and corals.
People visit elephant sanctuaries and national parks to see animals.
What do people eat in Thailand?
Thai food is spicy, flavorful, and delicious.
People eat rice noodles and vegetables, chicken, pork, seafood, and tofu, curry, herbs, and spices.
Popular Thai dishes, pad Thai, stir-fried noodles, tam yum, hot and sour soup, green curry, spicy coconut curry,
sometime papaya salad, mango sticky rice, sweet dessert.
What do people drink in Thailand?
People drink water, tea, and coffee.
Fruit juices, mango coconut pineapple, ice drinks, like Thai iced tea and Thai iced coffee, herbal drinks and coconut water.
Cold drinks are very popular because the weather is hot.
What is life like in Thailand?
Life in Thailand is peaceful, social, and fun.
People enjoy spending time with family, eating out at street food stalls, going to temples, watching TV, shopping, and playing sports.
Markets, food courts, and night bazaars are part of daily life.
What are some holidays and traditions in Thailand?
Songcrun, Thai New Year in April, with water fights.
Loy kritthong in November, people float lights on water.
Visakabucha Day to honor Buddha King's birthday, a national holiday.
Children's Day and Teacher's Day, people visit temples, give offerings, and enjoy festivals with music and dance.
Some fun facts about Thailand.
Thailand was never colonized, it stayed independent.
The Thai flag is red, white, and blue.
The Thai greeting is called white, hands together, and a bow.
Thailand has over 40,000 temples.
Thai massage is famous around the world.
Now you know many things about Thailand.
You know where it is, what people speak, and what they eat.
You learned about the weather, animals, culture, and daily life.
Great job!
I am Emily.
Goodbye, or as they say in Thai.
Sohastika.
